pageCache.text:
Pupils are happy and safe. They live up to the school’s high expectations of their behaviour.
A culture of respect is the hallmark of Highcliffe St Mark. It is this, that ensures a culture in whichpupils and adults are treated well.
My son's teacher this year really gets to know the children as individuals, and knows how to get the best from them all.
The facility and provision you have in place for emotional and social support is remarkable.
I find it difficult to find the words to describe my thanks to the foundation team, they are fantastic practitioners and offer such warmth and care each and every day. My daughter is the youngest in the class, but through their and her determination she has met every standard for a student in reception and has a glowing end of term report.
Reception Class Parent
My son has loved Fledglings from day one and it's such a breath of fresh air to have him stroll in happily everyday!
Welcome to our School
Welcome to Highcliffe St Mark Primary School
Highcliffe St Mark Primary School is a Church of England Foundation School where our Christian values of respect, courage and compassion are at the heart of everything we do. Rooted in Jesus’ teachings, these values guide our learning, relationships and the way we care for one another, helping every child to develop a strong sense of self-worth and responsibility for others.

pageCache.text:
Our Curriculum Vision and Curriculum Maps
Highcliffe St Mark Primary School
Curriculum Vision Statement
Rooted in our Christian values of respect, courage and compassion, our curriculum is designed to unlock the potential of every child. We aim to provide a high-quality, inclusive education that secures strong foundations in reading, writing, speaking, listening and maths, while nurturing children’s spiritual, moral, social, cultural, emotional and physical development. Our curriculum reflects our local context and prepares children to thrive as confident, compassionate citizens in modern Britain.
Leaders at all levels continually refine the curriculum to ensure ambition, coherence and progression. Learning is knowledge-rich, explorative and engaging, brought to life through real-world experiences, visits, visitors and strong community links. Carefully planned assessment identifies progress and gaps, enabling timely academic and emotional support. Pupil voice informs curriculum enrichment, and opportunities are planned to develop language, independence, resilience and interpersonal skills. Our local environment and global responsibilities shape meaningful learning experiences.
Children leave Highcliffe St Mark as articulate, curious and resilient learners with secure core skills and a love of learning. They demonstrate strong personal values, respect for others, and an understanding of their role in caring for their community and the wider world. Well-prepared for the next stage of education, our pupils are confident, reflective and ready to contribute positively to a diverse society.
Please find below the curriculum map for the whole school. This document provides an overview of the curriculum coverage and progression across all year groups. Should you require any clarification or further information, please contact the relevant class teacher, subject leader, or Mrs Fuller, the Curriculum Lead.
